CheckIn.description: How a row of the writing was cleaned: one of writing.corpus.VERDICTS.
CheckIn.title: CheckIn

Count.description: Rows by one value (a split, a year, a flag).
Count.title: Count

Coverage.description:
What the recordings cover. `prompts` counts those recorded and `seconds` what they took; `waiting` the generated
prompts still to record; `phonemised` is false when espeak is missing, so phonemes cannot be counted.
Coverage.title: Coverage

Folder.description: A folder the app uses, and the disk it is on (None when the folder does not exist yet).
Folder.title: Folder

Group.description:
One group of units: how many of its inventory have been said at least once (`inventory` null where the set is
open, as for pairs and stress patterns), and its units, least said first (every one of a known inventory, so the
missing ones show).
Group.title: Group

MediumCount.description:
One medium's rows: how many, how many trivial, words in the rest, the years they span, and how far the
person has got checking its cleaning sample (`checked` of `sample`, `clean` of those).
MediumCount.title: MediumCount

Problem.description: One reason a take should be recorded again, in words the speaker can act on.
Problem.title: Problem

PromptOut.description: A prompt with how far it has got: how many takes, and whether it was skipped.
PromptOut.title: PromptOut

Removed.description: A span taken out of a mail's original text (clean.py): `quote`, `forward`, `signature` or `client`.
Removed.title: Removed

ServiceStatus.description: Another strata service this app calls, as its health endpoint answered just now.
ServiceStatus.title: ServiceStatus

Studio.description: What the studio screen needs at once: may it record, what to say next (empty when the queue is done), how far.
Studio.title: Studio

SystemInfo.description: What `GET /api/system` answers: what is running, where its data is, and whether its services answer.
SystemInfo.title: SystemInfo

TakeOut.description:
A kept take, with the prompt it was recorded for and how it was judged (`verdict` null: not scored yet; the
other fields are explained in models.Take). Ids grow with time and are never reused.
TakeOut.title: TakeOut

Task.description: A job or task row as an API answers it.
Task.title: Task

UnitOut.description: One unit and how often it has been said; `example` is a word that has it, for a phoneme.
UnitOut.title: UnitOut

UploadOut.description:
An upload and how far it has got: `job` is its ingest job (null for one whose job was pruned). Of its
`sentences`, `kept` count in the dataset (with `kept_seconds` of speech), `other_voice` were someone else and
`retry` had another problem (cut, unclear, noisy). `speaker_reference` is what voices were compared with: `studio`,
`upload` (the voice that speaks most here) or null (not checked).
UploadOut.title: UploadOut

WriteIn.description: How many prompts to ask the writer for (1 to writer.MAX_COUNT).
WriteIn.title: WriteIn

WritingOut.description:
One thing the person wrote, as cleaned (the fields are explained in models.Writing). `original` is null when
nothing was taken out of it; `removed` are offsets into it.
WritingOut.title: WritingOut

WritingSummary.description:
What the writing holds: rows by medium, split, year and flag; the frozen split's cutoff and held-out
recipients; when it was last built and the newest build job (null: never built).
WritingSummary.title: WritingSummary

Written.description:
A batch: how many prompts the writer offered, how many were kept (the rest repeated a prompt or broke a rule),
which model wrote them, what it cost when the service says, and how many generated prompts now wait.
Written.title: Written

strata_python__contracts__Progress.description: How far a task has got. `total` None means not known yet; `text` is the line a person reads ("Page 3 of 40").
strata_python__contracts__Progress.title: Progress

stratavoice__studio__Progress.description:
How far through the queue the speaker is: `recorded` counts prompts with a usable take; `takes` and `seconds`
count every take kept, retries included.
stratavoice__studio__Progress.title: Progress
